main_measure.name: t of the slope of y (3-day return minus coin mean) on |forecast|, grid bars with forecast < 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t <= -2 and mean y < 0; reject: t >= +2 and mean y > 0; fewer than 50 cases: not decidable

decided_by: With at least 50 cases, the slope's t and the mean y meet neither the confirm nor the reject rule. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.928 (below 1), 301 cases (30 needed).
reading: Profile on each bar is read from the recorded regime (the 365-bar volatility percentile cannot be rebuilt inside a window) plus the 7-day return > 0 and the 60-day percent move < -10 where computable; the coin's mean 3-day return is the mean over the same non-overlapping grid of all its windows; fewer than 50 cases is reported as not observable.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.928 (below 1), 301 cases (30 needed)
